provenance_notes: Every package entry records the licence declaration of the exact resolved package; selected_license identifies the offered licence used for this cache when alternatives are available.

Files retain original full licence texts or exact line excerpts of upstream declarations/source notices. extracted_lines is a one-based inclusive range; source_sha256 authenticates the entire upstream file before extraction.

The SPDX MIT template is the published standard text, with literal copyright placeholders retained. It is accompanied by the upstream licence declaration and actual authors or copyright notice; no copyright year or ownership is inferred from author metadata.

For packages without published VCS metadata, commit identifies the upstream revision matched against all published non-Cargo source files and Cargo.toml.orig, rather than a claimed .cargo_vcs_info revision.
